areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Highly consistent: clear objectives, structured components, SMART indicators and significant resources; structuring design beyond buildings; exceptional impact potential and efficient solutions.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Expansion of digital health services and telehealth exists, but resources are limited and relative impact on the area is small; minimal fit.

areas.name: Poverty
areas.reason: Positive externalities of primary care are noted, but no objectives, indicators or targets tied to food insecurity or poverty.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Strengthening the health system yields positive externalities, but results are not structured with specific objectives, indicators or targets.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: No specific objectives, components, products or resources directed to women.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Health-facility works are counted under health; no integrated urban investment in mobility, housing, sanitation or infrastructure.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Only an indirect contribution to disaster response; no explicit objective, risk-management indicators or targets.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Technology initiatives focus on operational capacity; no structuring science and innovation actions or links to research institutions.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Relevant objectives on management modernization and training, but indicators are imprecise and resources relatively small; impacts already credited under health.
